instruction: Melissa has emailed me pictures of all trips we had together over the years. Which trip location has the least pictures?
notes: Three apps: supervisor, gmail, file_system. Melissa's email thread is located via gmail.show_inbox_threads (query 'pictures', pick the thread from Melissa), its zip attachment id via gmail.show_thread, then the attachment is downloaded (the only gmail.Attachment update the evaluation expects) and decompressed; file_system.show_directory (recursive) lists one folder per trip location and the agent counts pictures to pick the least-populated one. The answer location is a runtime placeholder object; static init facts (thread-matches, attachment-in-thread, saves-to, decompresses-to, trip-folders-in) encode the information chain. Decompression only adds file_system records, no files are updated/removed. supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all other actions.
